notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached to different creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block the creatures with Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creatures that have Spellbinder and Breath of Fury attached.
Spellbinder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Exotic Pets without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Exotic Pets, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Fish token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
